<script lang="ts">
	// a `//` in a stripped shell at the end of a paren head, then a comment after the `)`:
	// a block, a glued block, a `//`, and a block glued ahead of a `//`
	v = (a + b) // c1
		/* c2 */
		.h();
	v = (a + b) // c3
		/* c4 */ .h();
	v =
		// c6
		(
			a + b
		) // c5
		.h;
	v = (a + b) // c7
		/* c8 */ // c9
		.h();

	// no comment after the `)`, across the links
	v = (
		a + b
	) // c10
	.h;
	v = (a +
		b) // c11
	[k];
	v = (
		a + b
	) // c12
	?.h;
	v = (a + b).h // c13
		.i()
		.j();

	// an own-line `//`, a block and a multi-line block in the shell
	v = (a + b)
		// c14
		/* c15 */ .h();
	v = (a + b) /* c16 */ /* c17 */
		.h();
	v = (a + b) /** c18
	 */ // c19
	.h;

	// a logical chain, nested shells, and down a right spine
	v = (a && b) // c20
		/* c21 */
		.h();
	v = (a + b) // c22
		/* c23 */
		.h();
	v = (a + c * b) // c24
		/* c25 */
		.h();
	v =
		/* c27 */
		((m) => (k) =>
			y +
			b) // c26
		[k];
	v = (c ? d : e + b) // c28
		/* c29 */
		.h();
	v = (x = a + b) // c30
		/* c31 */ .h();
	function* gen() {
		v = (yield a + b) // c32
			/* c33 */ .h();
	}

	// a head whose binary breaks after a multi-line operand lays out as its comment-free twin
	v = (
		h(() => {
			throw x;
		}) + b
	) // c34
		.h();

	// a kept pair holds its own comment: one the operator requires, and a unary's
	v = (a - (b - c)) // c35
	/* c36 */
		.h();
	v = (
		a +
		typeof (
			x // c37
		)
	) /* c38 */
		.h();

	// at `return`, `throw`, `yield`, a declarator, a call argument and an `if` test
	function f() {
		return (
			// c40
			(
				a + b
			) // c39
			.h
		);
	}
	function g() {
		throw (
			(a + b) // c41
				/* c42 */
				.h()
		);
	}
	function* y() {
		yield; // c44
		(a +
			b) // c43
		[k];
	}
	const u =
		/* c46 */
		(
			a + b
		) // c45
		.h;
	q(
		// c48
		(
			a + b
		) // c47
		.h
	);
	if (
		/* c50 */
		(
			a + b
		) // c49
		.h
	) {
	}
	function k() {
		return (a + b) /** c51
		 */ /* c52 */
			.h();
	}

	// in a callback
	foo(function () {
		return (
			/* c54 */
			(
				a + b
			) // c53
			.h
		);
	});
</script>
